title: Дурак · полный записанный корпус
summary: Complete reviewed Durak1.0.1, adapted to Forge without changing its rules; this is recorded source, not model-generated quality evidence.
genre: 2–4-player card game, one human and computer opponents
rules: 36 cards, ranks6 through ace, one bottom trump drawn last
Ordinary throwing Durak; no transfers, teams or trump-six swap
Fixed min(6, starting defender hand) attack limit
Original attacker gets throw priority; defender draws last
Human may voluntarily take; taking cannot be cancelled
Only final settlement declares remaining durak or genuine all-empty draw

No seed, opponent hands or deck order.", "/paused": "Transient pause belongs to the live controller; it is not restored from a previous mount.", "/totalCards": "Read-only sum of cards in hands, draw pile, board and discard; always36.", "/events": "Presentation event records with session/revision IDs; never a source of card accounting.", "/persistence/status": "Actual UI persistence result: empty, saved, memory, or conflict. Conflicts preserve live play."}
visual_direction: Full original responsive emerald/ivory DOM table, procedural SVG card faces, card-motion CSS and reduced-motion media query; no bitmap assets or fake Canvas.
audio_direction: Original short synthesized card/deal/outcome effects; no ambient music. Mute/hide cancels complete effect chains and never replays suspended events.
controls: Pointer/touch selects a card then plays it
2–4 participant selector, rules, new game, sound and quick tempo
win_condition: The human exits with no cards after the deck is empty; bot play continues to a final table outcome
lose_condition: The human is the sole remaining hand at final settlement
acceptance_criteria: Play a complete first bout, settle it once, retain all36 cards and continue to the next attack
A human may choose take even with a legal defense; throwing and pickup settle once
Paused inputs do not consume cards; resuming permits the same legal attack
Restore a real save after legal progress and replay the same continuation to the same public position
Malformed or incompatible saves cannot replace the live card position
Hidden input is rejected and remount restores the actual saved position without resetting a deal
Actual quota and denied storage leave accepted card moves in memory and show truthful save status
A settled table cannot be credited or drawn a second time by a repeated continuation

timing.pause_policy: Only one authorized card decision or settlement changes the position. UI delays affect presentation and bot scheduling; hidden/manual pause cancels pending work.

fields.meaning: Null in the menu; otherwise a fresh viewer0 observation with public board/counts and only the human hand and legal actions. No seed, opponent hands or deck order.
Transient pause belongs to the live controller; it is not restored from a previous mount.
Read-only sum of cards in hands, draw pile, board and discard; always36.
Presentation event records with session/revision IDs; never a source of card accounting.
Actual UI persistence result: empty, saved, memory, or conflict. Conflicts preserve live play.

transitions.effect: Move one actor-owned card to the table; defender decides
Cover the chosen attack or commit irreversible taking; original attacker regains priority

transitions.trigger: legal throw after take or pass
transitions.effect: Respect fixed defender-start attack limit and table rank set

transitions.trigger: all attackers pass or fixed limit reached
transitions.effect: Freeze complete visible bout and clear actor
Move table exactly once, draw attacker-first and defender-last, select next active neighbors
Set single remaining durak or genuine all-empty draw only after settlement

resources.name: mounted-session
resources.acquire: Mount one DOM session and listeners; lazy audio context after activation
resources.release: Destroy cancels bot timeout, removes listeners and closes audio; remount reads current valid localStorage
resources.stale_work_policy: Check session, revision and independent task ticket before touching the active timer handle. Reconcile resume/suspend completion against the current desired state.

resources.name: audio-session
resources.acquire: GameAudio receives the UI-owned context and creates independent music/SFX buses; track and bound each entire effect chain to32 active sources
resources.release: Mute/hide cancel sources and disconnect chains; dispose releases buses without closing the supplied context
resources.stale_work_policy: Discard muted/suspended-context events, bounded ID deduplication and no replay; UI resource owner reconciles both late resume and late suspend

invariants.statement: Each of36 rank/suit cards exists in exactly one hand, deck, table slot or discard.
invariants.check_strategy: Independent identity multiset after every public action in a finite full-match matrix; verify the original validator too

invariants.statement: Only the current actor chooses; each bot receives its own copied filtered observation, never full game state.
invariants.check_strategy: Assert no deck order/seed/opponent hands, copied view mutation isolation, and legality of every chosen bot action

invariants.statement: Taking is a legal voluntary defense alternative; further throws stay bounded and the entire board moves once.
invariants.check_strategy: A human chooses take while legal defenses exist, then legal throw/pass/settlement and repeated-continue rejection

invariants.statement: Selected card, focused control and original modal opener have separate lifetimes.
invariants.check_strategy: Original reviewed DOM handlers retained; focused integration smoke remains separate from a browser layout claim

state_domains.reset_policy: Explicit newGame creates one new shuffled deal; full hidden position is authoritative in GameEngine.state
state_domains.preserve_policy: Serialize validated36-card state, including actor, priority, phase, limit and committed taking; UI sees only derived observation

state_domains.reset_policy: Accepted action/reinitialization replaces or clears event list
state_domains.preserve_policy: Never restore audio or settle cards from historical event replay

state_domains.reset_policy: New mount resets transient pause and reads actual saved bytes
state_domains.preserve_policy: Failed writes leave playable state in memory with truthful status

preconditions: phase is roundEnd and actor is null
All36 unique cards and phase relations validate
commit: Move the entire board once to discard or defender
Mark empty-deck players out and assign next turn or terminal outcome
transactions.repeat_policy: Repeated continue in the next phase is rejected without another pickup or draw

validation_rules: Exactly36 unique cards; real rank/suit identities and bottom trump
Validate actor/neighbor, card ownership, table-rank sequence, beats, pass priority, limit and terminal relations
persistence.migration_policy: Only supported current format accepted; corrupt or unknown versions cannot replace the live game
persistence.write_policy: One complete envelope after accepted actions; explicit newGame may claim the slot; no teardown write
persistence.conflict_policy: Compare actual serialized durable bytes to observed baseline; sticky conflict preserves this live branch. This is best effort, not an atomic cross-tab CAS.
persistence.failure_policy: Quota/denied or a changed slot leaves in-memory play and reports memory/conflict; rejected manual import preserves state

first_playable_loop.description: A human attacks, bots respond and a full bout settles to the next legal round with all cards conserved

limitations: A specialized privileged full-state reference oracle checks every filtered bot input; the public QA bridge does not expose hidden hands.
Independent stale callbacks are additionally invoked in a controlled exact-HTML timer model; synthetic hide/show is not operating-system backgrounding.
Specialized exact-HTML two-document shared-storage test; no cross-process atomicity claim.
Original reviewed focus handlers retained; exact-HTML focused-control integration uses explicit DOM focus model rather than native keyboard/layout.
Specialized deferred-resume model verifies mute reconciliation on exact HTML; real device audio and BFCache are not exercised.
